# Awesome Codex + Blender + Seedance Workflows

> A zero-dependency, executable repository for compiling structured Codex shot plans into Blender gray-box previs videos and reviewed Seedance 2.0 requests through HiAPI.

## Start here

- Read `/AGENTS.md` before editing a shot.
- Copy one `/examples/*/shot.json` file into a new example directory.
- Run `npm test`, then `npm run render -- <shot.json> --out-dir <output>`.
- Review the complete previs before running the HiAPI dry run.
- Never submit a paid task without the exact current preflight token and user approval.

## Important files

- `/schemas/shot-spec.schema.json`: public shot contract.
- `/scripts/lib/spec.mjs`: validation and compilation.
- `/scripts/blender/render_previs.py`: constrained Blender renderer.
- `/scripts/submit.mjs`: dry-run, submit, poll, resume, and download lifecycle.
- `/docs/PLAN.md`: current and future scope.
- `/docs/research.md`: related projects and non-copying boundary.
